body:
Lead, 14 Nov 2026 12:00 UTC, what is happening (for whoever reads the board next):
MERGED today (all built, not walked): N-11 (A, B-server, B-phone), N-12, N-13 drawing + B-122/P2-26 outage fix (#45), N-20, N-21, N-22, N-23a, N-24, N-25, P1-07, P1-10, P1-16, P1-26/26b, P2-28 (#48), P4-24, lost-pause fix; board notes with the emulator checks are #43/#44/#46/#47.
IN THE MERGE QUEUE one at a time (each waits ~12 to 15 min of CI): #49 B-58 outbox wakes itself, #50 B-57 unknown word does not start the server, #52 B-41 music-server outage is not a wrong password (checked against the real Navidrome: code 40 for wrong token, unknown user and no credentials alike), #51 N-15 artist pictures (helper-n15), #53 N-13 code (helper-n13; migration renumbered to 0013 because #51 takes 0012), #54 board hygiene (P2-26 built). Chains: scratchpad merge_chain3.sh.
NEXT (advisor, 14 Nov): no new feature code until the queue is empty. Then freeze one main commit, let CI publish sha-<commit>, build the debug APK from the same commit, update VM 108 to that sha (logged with its undo in local/homelab-changes-2026-11-13.md), install on the emulator only (never the A35), and walk the built items as a stranger would: engineering checks, labelled 'verified on an emulator against VM 108 updated to sha-<commit> (engineering check, not the release-candidate pair)'. A row is 'walked' only on the real release-candidate pair (published image installed by the guide on a clean machine + same-commit APK, docs/tasks/RELEASE-CANDIDATE.md section 1); VM 108's clean snapshot lacks the pull credential for the private image, so that pair needs the owner's help or a public image: not done.
AFTER the walk: P1-17 (one reach state) goes to a helper (it touches the player, playability and search: it would collide with N-13's app half). Open findings: B-121 (rows without a menu; a long press plays and costs a look-up), B-125 (YouTube channels saved as artists by the importer; helper-n15 found it, needs its own item), N-14 plan (persist the catalogue artist per library artist / P2-12), N-23b design on N-23, P1-07 'busta' ranking question for N-16.
